name: web-next
description: For a Next.js or React web project: a Vitest and Testing Library preset, a check of translation keys, and rules for Next.js. Install the base pack first.
manual: Set `test: "<package manager> test"` in the gate block of harness/pinned-config.yaml, and add "vitest.config.*" and "vitest.setup.*" to gate_config_files.
Write the first tests for pure functions (formatters, validators, mappers). Put each test next to its code: a.ts has a.test.ts.
If the project has translation files: add the script "i18n:check": "node tools/i18n-check.mjs <locales folder>", run it one time with --baseline, and add it to the lint command of the gate.
Next.js: a clean checkout has no next-env.d.ts, so the typecheck can fail before the first build. Put `node tools/ensure-next-env.mjs &&` before the typecheck command of the gate.
